copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app

howto.what: 把 Discord 机器人接入 NanoClaw:从 channels 分支拷入适配器并注册、安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0,再引导你创建 Discord 应用、粘贴 Bot Token,推导并写入凭据、重启服务、开通你自己的私信频道。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人频道时就会触发:包括正处于 /setup 流程中,或之后用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 接线时。

howto.what_en: Adds a Discord bot channel: copies the adapter from the channels branch and registers it, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, then guides Discord app setup, Bot Token paste, credential storage, restart, and DM channel opening.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw — during /setup, or later via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.
